status.title: Status
status.name: Name
status.unseal_mode_manual_description: Unseal keys are required after every restart
status.configure_first_description: Set the host name and the unseal mode to start OpenBao.
status.initialize_description: Open the OpenBao web UI to initialize it. Store the root token and the keys it shows in a safe place: they are displayed only once and cannot be recovered.
status.initialize_description_auto: Open the OpenBao web UI to initialize it. Store the root token and the recovery keys it shows in a safe place: they are displayed only once and cannot be recovered.
status.sealed_description: Secrets cannot be accessed until OpenBao is unsealed. Open the OpenBao web UI and enter {threshold} of the {shares} unseal keys. Keys entered so far: {progress}.
status.sealed_auto_description: Automatic unseal did not succeed. Check the system logs of the application.
status.not_running_description: Check the system logs of the application for errors.

settings.title: Settings
settings.host_helper: OpenBao API and web UI are published at this address
settings.unseal_mode_manual_description: OpenBao starts sealed after every restart, including updates and node reboots. An operator must enter the unseal keys. The keys never touch the server disk.
settings.unseal_mode_auto_description: A static key, generated and stored on the node and included in backups, unseals OpenBao at startup. Anyone with access to the node disk or to the backup can decrypt the stored secrets.
settings.unseal_mode_locked: The unseal mode cannot be changed after OpenBao is initialized
settings.unseal_mode_cannot_verify: Start OpenBao before changing the unseal mode
settings.restart_warning_description: Changing the host name or the unseal mode restarts OpenBao. With manual unseal it must be unsealed again afterwards.
settings.audit_log_helper: Record every OpenBao request in the system logs. Sensitive values are hashed.
settings.domain_already_used_in_traefik: Domain already used by another application
settings.host_pattern: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.host_format: Must be a valid fully qualified domain name
settings.directory_description: Let the users of a NethServer user domain log in to OpenBao with their account. Members of the administrators group get full access to OpenBao.
settings.ldap_admin_group_helper: Members of this group get the ns8-admin policy, with full access to OpenBao
settings.auto_initialize: Initialize OpenBao automatically with directory login
settings.auto_initialize_warning_title: No root token and no recovery keys
settings.auto_initialize_warning_description: OpenBao initializes itself and members of the administrators group can log in at once. No root token or recovery keys are generated: after the first login, generate recovery keys with "bao operator rotate-keys -init -target=recovery" and store them in a safe place.
settings.setup_ldap_description: OpenBao is already initialized or uses manual unseal, so the module cannot configure it without an administrator token. After saving, run this command on the node and enter an OpenBao token when prompted. Run it again if the user domain credentials change.
settings.ldap_admin_group_not_found: Group not found in the user domain
settings.ldap_admin_group_cannot_verify: Cannot verify the group: the user domain does not answer
settings.auto_initialize_requires_user_domain: Automatic initialization requires a user domain
settings.notifications_description: Send an email when OpenBao goes down or is sealed, and when it recovers. Messages are sent through the cluster SMTP smarthost. Cluster alert recipients are also notified by the NethServer alert system.
settings.smarthost_disabled_description: Email notifications cannot be sent until the cluster SMTP smarthost is enabled.
settings.notify_recipients_helper: Comma-separated email addresses. Leave empty to disable notifications
settings.notify_recipients_required: Enter at least one email address
settings.smarthost_disabled: The cluster SMTP smarthost is not enabled
settings.test_email_failed_description: Check the SMTP smarthost settings and the system logs of the application.
